## Gate declaration

- [ ] Protected architecture/product decisions are unchanged or separately owner-authorized.
- [ ] No test, threshold, baseline, platform, dependency, license, or release gate was weakened.
- [ ] Only intentional paths were staged.
- [ ] The remote branch SHA matches the verified local commit.
- [ ] Required documentation and artifacts are updated.
- [ ] The PR contains no unrelated cleanup or speculative modules.
